manual.accumulators.line2: {0}§lAccumulators§r serve as energy storage units. Input and output power is limited to one connector of the voltage of the accumulator per side.
manual.accumulators.line4: Side configuration can be adjusted with the hammer: Blue corresponds to input, orange corresponds to output, and no colour marking preventing any connection at all.
manual.accumulators.line6: Sneaking while configuring a side will configure the side opposite to the one that was clicked.
